fields.title: Rig gamma uses the Be denominator for the proposed aluminium article
fields.evidence: The article definition requires its own Kc*p_classical. Be p_H=169.207732590530 kPa; 5052-O p_H=174.466866567275 kPa. Sea-level/5m-water gamma is 0.575037552829/0.856083753548 for 5052-O, versus card 0.592910711208/0.882692312307. The latter reproduces on the Be reference.
fields.proposed_fix: Label a Be-equivalent reference separately; report measured article gamma against its own section. Specify whether water head is measured above the pole.

claim: Rig gamma uses the Be denominator for the proposed aluminium article
numerical_scope: Source NFI carried without a new independent check
qualification: 047's regularizing in-plane core moduli remain unsourced, and its face-compression screen uses a tensile proxy. The 1.209–1.227 mm tolerance at SF1 is model-only. The 056 target, 6.03 MPa, is simulated rather than a physical collapse measurement; 6.159 MPa agreement supplies no P2 gamma. [047 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:7472c3f9ee41a250), [056 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:a6b49a9c06df2016).
